run refuses any existing complete or partial attempt-001 before creation; active.lock uses wx. Runtime failure after workspace creation leaves preserved partial run. Process crash leaves lock and partial artifacts; neither is silently deleted or retried. There is no repair/replacement attempt.

Validation captures before/after whole BASE tree; freeze compares current tree to validation and checks approved task/acceptance hashes. Inputs include entire staged dataset, independent review, model/runtime/core implementation and supplementary event accountant. Frozen() compares exact current inputs and limits before run/replay. Fixture/review/validation were not yet present in this worktree at initial inspection.

Shared post-response timer, tool/turn checks and cost accounting receive staged limits. budgetEligible checks completed status, finite known cost, turns/calls and finite latency <=480s. One run prevents aggregate replacement spending. Artifact/free disk checks occur before attempt; no hard OS storage/wall-time/dollar boundary is claimed.

Independent workspace is created with mkdir and not overwritten; every patch path is allowlisted and baseline before bytes checked. Visible+hidden grades rerun. Usage compares durable assistant events to result; unknown check combines durable events and actual worker usageCostUnknown, retaining failed/pruned response uncertainty.

>=20 responses and >=32768 peak input tokens is predeclared as an exploratory descriptive flag. Structural scopeTier3 does not prove actual duration/necessary architecture. Compaction/delegation/persistence remain false; one attempt cannot show optimization or superiority.

findings.title: Eligibility predicate uses worker unknown flag while result uses combined unknown flag
findings.evidence: eligible=budgetEligible(w,LIMITS), while totalEstimatedUsd/unknownTotal combine accountEvents(events).unknown OR w.usageCostUnknown.
findings.impact: If durable event accounting ever finds unknown usage not reflected by the worker flag, a result could have success=true with unknown total. Current shared agent sets worker unknown on errors/missing costs; no observed mismatch is asserted.
findings.suggestion: Before freeze, use the combined unknown predicate for eligibility as well, or assert equality and fail closed on mismatch.

limitations: No OS sandbox/network denial is added; shared Node filesystem permissions and minimal environment do not prove network isolation.
No fixture semantics or stated smoke/public/hidden counts were independently checked because the staged dataset had not arrived at initial review.
